subject.title: [Feature]: Add exact Feishu DM conversation routing with fail-closed enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw support an opt-in Feishu-only exact-DM binding and fail-closed routing mode that intentionally rejects unmatched DMs instead of falling back to the main agent?
rationale: This introduces a new selector and configuration policy whose enabled behavior deliberately changes message dispatch outcomes; the intended permanent routing and upgrade contract requires maintainer judgment.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded Feishu contract
options.body: Approve a plugin-owned opt-in mode with explicit account scoping, default compatibility behavior, user-facing recovery diagnostics, and focused routing proof.

options.title: Keep the existing routing model
options.body: Decline the new exact conversation selector and fail-closed mode, retaining sender/current fallback semantics.

options.title: Request a narrower platform seam
options.body: Defer implementation until maintainers define a generic routing API that is justified beyond Feishu.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded Feishu contract
recommendation.body: Approve a plugin-owned opt-in mode with explicit account scoping, default compatibility behavior, user-facing recovery diagnostics, and focused routing proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidenced stakeholder for the exact operational requirement and the linked proposed implementation.
